text_block_list.text:
Just before the start of the Saudi Arabia
R.C., the
student council's general
manager comes to wish
Симболи Рудольф
well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Rudolf instructs the manager to watch
her
performance in the race, and the
manager nods.
With that, Rudolf departs
for the race full of
confidence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
